predicates.registry_semantics: A named element of the specified kind belongs to the closed declaration inventory.
predicates.typed_acceptance: Requires string kind, element, and scope; runtime accepts only state, event, transition/edge kinds and closed_fcstm or root declaration scope.
predicates.backend_domain: Parsed native pyfcstm StateMachine declaration inventory.
predicates.quantifier: Exact membership equality for one named declaration.
predicates.scope: Whole closed FCSTM declaration inventory or its root declaration scope; no arbitrary owner-local scope.
predicates.timing_rtc: Static authored declaration fact; no execution or RTC semantics.
predicates.observable: Exact state, event, or transition carrier identity.
predicates.approximation: Exact only for the supported vocabulary and declared closed scope; it establishes neither reachability nor behavior.
predicates.bound_domain: No temporal bound; finite parsed declaration inventory.
predicates.boolean_boundary: Boolean only after native load and complete typed binding; unsupported kind/scope or loader failure is unknown, not false.
predicates.evaluation_only_reuse: Reuse only for a source-backed claim that one exact supported declaration must exist or must be absent in the closed authored model.
semantic_gaps: no requirement that a declared state is reachable
missing_test_cases: Reject a non-root S1 scope without misreporting false
distinguish an absent declaration from native-load failure

predicates.registry_semantics: A transition exists between the specified source and target.
predicates.typed_acceptance: Requires scalar string source, target, and scope; optional transition carrier narrows lookup but does not alter the endpoint query.
predicates.backend_domain: Native authored transition carriers and canonical endpoint identities.
predicates.quantifier: Existential: any exact carrier in the chosen scope has the requested endpoints.
predicates.scope: closed_fcstm or one exact resolvable owner state.
predicates.timing_rtc: Static edge fact only; no event, guard, completion, hierarchy-exit, or RTC behavior is checked.
predicates.observable: Exact source and target endpoint pair on a native transition carrier.
predicates.approximation: Carrier lookup includes forced/composite provenance only for exact authored carrier matching; it is not arbitrary path reachability.
predicates.bound_domain: No temporal bound; finite carrier inventory.
predicates.boolean_boundary: Boolean only after native load, exact string endpoints, and valid owner scope; invalid bindings are unknown.
predicates.evaluation_only_reuse: Exact for a source-backed direct authored edge obligation with explicit endpoints and an unambiguous closed or owner-local scope.
semantic_gaps: cannot establish a required direct edge if source only says eventual reachability
missing_test_cases: A composite owner and a same-name leaf must not collapse
a forced carrier must not create path-level reachability

predicates.registry_semantics: The parsed trigger set of a transition equals the required trigger set.
predicates.typed_acceptance: An exact transition:line carrier plus a tuple of non-empty required trigger strings; the empty tuple deliberately denotes no trigger.
predicates.quantifier: Set equality on one exact transition carrier.
predicates.scope: One grammar-span transition carrier, not a path or state scope.
predicates.timing_rtc: Static parsed trigger attachment; it does not test dispatch, consumption, or RTC priority.
predicates.observable: Set of exact parsed event names.
predicates.approximation: Exact syntactic trigger-set equality only; free-text interpretation remains outside the predicate.
predicates.boolean_boundary: Unknown for no exact carrier or malformed trigger values; completed Boolean compares observed and required sets.
predicates.evaluation_only_reuse: Exact for an authored transition whose required event set, including intentional eventlessness, is source-backed and parseable.
semantic_gaps: cannot decide whether prose after a colon was intended as action versus trigger
missing_test_cases: Empty trigger tuple must remain distinct from missing typed binding
comma-containing source text must not be silently split into several events

predicates.registry_semantics: The specified action is attached to the specified lifecycle phase of the specified state.
predicates.typed_acceptance: Requires a resolvable state, phase exactly entry/do/exit, and one string action identity.
predicates.quantifier: Membership of one normalized action in one exact lifecycle slot.
predicates.scope: One exact native state and its entry, do, or exit collection.
predicates.timing_rtc: Static lifecycle attachment; actual action scheduling and operation semantics are not executed.
predicates.observable: Normalized action text in the requested lifecycle collection.
predicates.approximation: Exact only for parseable/native lifecycle action attachment; no general transition effect or arbitrary action language.
predicates.boolean_boundary: Unknown when the state/phase/action binding is not valid; Boolean only for a completed native collection lookup.
predicates.evaluation_only_reuse: Exact for a stated lifecycle-slot attachment requirement with a single exact state and action identity.
missing_test_cases: Same action in entry and do must not satisfy the wrong phase
unparseable prose must return unknown rather than false

predicates.registry_semantics: The parsed guard of a transition equals the required guard.
predicates.typed_acceptance: Requires an exact carrier and either an empty string for an absent guard or an FCSTM-parseable guard expression.
predicates.quantifier: AST equality for one exact transition guard.
predicates.timing_rtc: Static guard syntax/AST equality; it does not solve or explore guard satisfiability.
predicates.observable: Parsed native guard AST or deliberate absent guard.
predicates.approximation: Exact syntactic AST equality within the FCSTM expression grammar, not semantic equivalence of arbitrary formulas.
predicates.bound_domain: No temporal bound; no valuation domain is searched.
predicates.boolean_boundary: Bad carrier or unparseable expected guard yields unknown; only parsed AST equality yields Boolean.
predicates.evaluation_only_reuse: Exact for a source-backed requirement whose one expected guard has a single FCSTM parse and one exact carrier.
missing_test_cases: Equivalent but differently parenthesized guard ASTs
a free-text guard that cannot parse must not be a Boolean false

predicates.registry_semantics: The specified effect belongs to the effect set of the specified transition.
predicates.typed_acceptance: S6Inputs accepts an effect tuple, but backend accepts only a tuple of length one containing one string expression.
predicates.quantifier: Existential membership of one parsed effect AST on one exact transition.
predicates.timing_rtc: Static effect attachment; no effect execution or ordering semantics.
predicates.observable: One parsed native operation AST among transition effects.
predicates.approximation: Runtime is a strict one-effect fragment despite registry wording about an effect set and tuple-typed schema.
predicates.boolean_boundary: More than one effect, a non-string, a bad carrier, or unparsable expression yields unknown; only one parseable effect membership yields Boolean.
predicates.evaluation_only_reuse: Reuse only for one source-backed, single, parseable transition effect; never use it to prove completeness, ordering, or a conjunction of effects.
missing_test_cases: Tuple with two effects must demonstrate the registry/backend mismatch
single effect must remain distinguishable from an effect sequence

predicates.registry_semantics: A finite graph path exists from the source set to the target set.
predicates.typed_acceptance: Requires nonempty exact source and target state values that resolve through native leaf projection.
predicates.scope: Resolved native source and target leaf configurations; composite/root values expand through fixed native projection.
predicates.timing_rtc: Finite topology macro-edge reachability; event, guard, data, and runtime priority are discarded.
predicates.approximation: Positive reachability is an over-approximation of executable behavior because topology ignores guard/event/order feasibility.
predicates.bound_domain: Finite graph closure; no user-specified temporal horizon.
predicates.boolean_boundary: Unresolvable/empty bindings or native load failure are unknown; Boolean only for the graph query.
predicates.evaluation_only_reuse: Use only as a proxy or exact topology-only claim explicitly limited to macro-graph connectivity.
missing_test_cases: Guard-disabled graph edge must remain a documented over-approximation
composite source expansion must be stable

predicates.registry_semantics: Under the declared graph completion, every path from the source eventually visits the target.
predicates.typed_acceptance: Requires exactly one resolved source leaf and one or more resolved target leaves.
predicates.backend_domain: Native FBMCQ bounded execution from one exact initialized source.
predicates.quantifier: Universal over admissible executions within the chosen finite BMC horizon.
predicates.scope: One exact source leaf; target is a disjunction of exact leaves.
predicates.timing_rtc: Bounded execution semantics, not unbounded eventuality.
predicates.observable: Target leaf active within finite horizon.
predicates.approximation: The bound is max(1, native state count); no proof of unbounded liveness or behavior beyond the finite horizon.
predicates.bound_domain: Horizon derived mechanically from number of native states.
predicates.boolean_boundary: No Boolean if binding fails, solver fails, times out, or native load fails; false is only a completed BMC counterexample.
predicates.evaluation_only_reuse: Exact only when the obligation itself states the same finite, source-specific BMC horizon; otherwise an explicitly bounded proxy.
semantic_gaps: implicit environment is the BMC admissible execution set
missing_test_cases: A counterexample beyond state-count horizon
unbounded NL eventuality must be rejected as exact G2

predicates.registry_semantics: Every path from the source to the target avoids the forbidden node or edge set.
predicates.typed_acceptance: Requires one exact source, target set, and nonempty forbidden values; backend rejects edge and composite carriers after leaf binding.
predicates.quantifier: Backend disproves universal avoidance by existential source-to-forbidden-to-target topology composition.
predicates.scope: One exact native leaf source, exact leaf targets, and exact leaf forbidden states.
predicates.timing_rtc: Static macro topology; no event/guard/runtime condition.
predicates.observable: Topological path through an exact forbidden leaf state.
predicates.approximation: Registry promises node-or-edge avoidance, but runtime is state-only exact-leaf topology; topology also over-approximates execution.
predicates.boolean_boundary: Invalid source, empty forbidden set, edge carrier, nonleaf carrier, or load failure is unknown; only graph composition yields Boolean.
predicates.evaluation_only_reuse: Exact only for a topology-only source obligation about one leaf-state forbidden node; all edge, composite, or executable-route claims are unsupported/proxy.
missing_test_cases: Registry edge input must be rejected as a boundary rather than false
a composite forbidden state must be rejected explicitly

predicates.registry_semantics: Every root-reachable node can reach a marked node along a finite path.
predicates.typed_acceptance: Requires nonempty root and marked values resolving through native leaf projection.
predicates.quantifier: Universal over nodes topologically reachable from roots; existential continuation to one marked node per node.
predicates.scope: Resolved source/target leaf configurations; root/composite expansion follows native projection.
predicates.timing_rtc: Finite topology path only; no executable progress or termination semantics.
predicates.observable: Each root-reachable leaf's topology path to a marked leaf.
predicates.approximation: Topology ignores events, guards, data, scheduling, and fairness; it is not a deadlock or termination proof.
predicates.boolean_boundary: Missing native bindings/load failure are unknown; Boolean only after full finite graph scan.
predicates.evaluation_only_reuse: Exact for a deliberately topology-only coaccessibility obligation with stated roots/marked leaves; otherwise proxy.
missing_test_cases: Marked state unreachable under disabled guard demonstrates topology boundary
root expansion across a composite scope

predicates.registry_semantics: The exact event occurs and is consumed in the declared macrostep.
predicates.typed_acceptance: Schema declares scenario, event, and step, but actual backend requires only scenario event plus scenario.selected_step and does not read plan.inputs['step'].
predicates.backend_domain: One fully supplied native runtime macrostep schedule with selected-step attribution.
predicates.scope: One complete finite schedule and selected event/carrier/before-after attribution.
predicates.timing_rtc: Actual FCSTM macrostep/RTC runtime cycle for the declared schedule.
predicates.observable: Selected queued/consumed event, selected carrier, and active states before/after.
predicates.approximation: Exact only if source itself supplies the complete schedule and attribution; registry step field is disconnected from runtime selection.
predicates.bound_domain: Finite supplied schedule, no automatic environment exploration.
predicates.boolean_boundary: Runtime/load/input failures are unknown; completed event-attribution check alone yields Boolean.
predicates.evaluation_only_reuse: Reuse only after gold binds the exact selected step inside scenario and records it redundantly as provenance; reject proposals relying on independent plan-level step control.
semantic_gaps: plan-level step does not constrain the backend
missing_test_cases: Changing only R1Inputs.step must not change the receipt and must be caught by the gold validator
selected_step must match the frozen scenario schedule

predicates.registry_semantics: The target state is active in the trailing portion of the declared trace window.
predicates.typed_acceptance: Requires a fully defined scenario, exact stimulus, native state, and closed inclusive window.
predicates.backend_domain: Actual native runtime trace from one finite supplied macrostep schedule.
predicates.quantifier: For the last matching stimulus in the inclusive window, target is active in every strictly later trace row.
predicates.scope: One finite runtime trace and explicit inclusive window.
predicates.timing_rtc: The stimulus row is excluded; a trailing observation is required after the stimulus macrostep.
predicates.observable: Native active-state path for recorded macrosteps.
predicates.approximation: Not a general eventually-after semantics; it selects only the last stimulus and checks finite trailing rows.
predicates.bound_domain: Closed supplied schedule and inclusive [start,end] window.
predicates.boolean_boundary: No qualified stimulus, no later row, invalid window/state, runtime/load failure are unknown; false only follows a completed trace comparison.
predicates.evaluation_only_reuse: Exact only for an obligation explicitly quantifying the last occurrence in one supplied finite window and requiring persistence on every later observed row.
missing_test_cases: Two stimuli in one window must demonstrate last-stimulus selection
stimulus at the final row must return unknown rather than true

predicates.registry_semantics: The specified behavior occurs at the specified owner and slot within the trace.
predicates.typed_acceptance: Requires full scenario, one exact named abstract native lifecycle action, and a closed macrostep window; concrete operation blocks are rejected.
predicates.backend_domain: FBMCQ called() over a fixed native event schedule.
predicates.quantifier: Existential occurrence within one fixed schedule/window.
predicates.scope: One named abstract lifecycle action and finite closed macrostep interval.
predicates.timing_rtc: BMC query uses the supplied scenario event assumptions; it is not observational logging of arbitrary actions.
predicates.approximation: No concrete operation/action blocks, no universal schedule quantification, and no claim about arbitrary effect execution.
predicates.bound_domain: Bound is schedule length and window is closed macrostep interval.
predicates.boolean_boundary: Invalid behavior/window, load/solver error, timeout, or incomplete solve is not false; only terminal Boolean counts.
predicates.evaluation_only_reuse: Exact only for one source-backed named abstract lifecycle-call occurrence under a fully source-specified schedule; otherwise unsupported/proxy.
missing_test_cases: Concrete operation block must reject as unknown
occurrence outside window must be distinguishable from absent action

predicates.registry_semantics: The target state remains active at every recorded point in the closed interval.
predicates.typed_acceptance: Requires a full scenario, exact native state, and closed inclusive macrostep interval.
predicates.backend_domain: Actual native runtime trace from a fixed schedule.
predicates.quantifier: Universal over recorded rows in one closed interval.
predicates.scope: One exact state within a supplied finite trace interval.
predicates.timing_rtc: Post-cycle macrostep observations only; no inference between sampled stable configurations.
predicates.observable: Exact state membership in each recorded active-state set.
predicates.approximation: Finite sampled retention, not continuous time, universal executions, or hierarchy-level occupancy unless native path resolves it.
predicates.bound_domain: Declared finite inclusive interval within schedule.
predicates.boolean_boundary: Invalid state/interval, loader/runtime failure are unknown; Boolean only after trace observation completes.
predicates.evaluation_only_reuse: Exact only for a source-defined finite sampled macrostep retention obligation with complete schedule.
missing_test_cases: Interval endpoints must be inclusive
parent state occupancy must not be silently substituted for exact leaf state

predicates.registry_semantics: No two guards in the same choice group are simultaneously satisfiable within the declared domain.
predicates.typed_acceptance: Registry/schema declare source, trigger, domain; backend additionally requires the supplied guard multiset to equal the resolved native choice-group guards.
predicates.backend_domain: One native same-source/same-trigger choice group encoded in FBMCQ.
predicates.quantifier: Universal absence of a jointly satisfiable pair within the bound domain of one resolved group.
predicates.scope: One exact source/trigger group, including explicit null trigger for eventless group.
predicates.timing_rtc: Static guard satisfiability in BMC; no runtime priority or inter-group conflict semantics.
predicates.observable: Guard AST multiset and satisfiability under closed declared domain.
predicates.approximation: Runtime needs a hidden extra guards binding not declared by registry; source-level domain completeness remains a caller obligation.
predicates.bound_domain: Closed declared domain and resolved native guard multiset.
predicates.boolean_boundary: Group mismatch, missing guards, invalid domain/source, or solver failure yields unknown; false only after a completed overlapping-guard witness.
predicates.evaluation_only_reuse: Reuse only when gold binds the exact native choice group and independently reproduces its complete guard multiset; otherwise mark unsupported rather than fabricate guards.
semantic_gaps: declared registry inputs do not fully bind runtime
missing_test_cases: Changing only hidden guards must prevent Boolean execution
registry-visible inputs must not be falsely represented as complete binding

predicates.registry_semantics: The disjunction of guards in the same choice group covers the declared input domain.
predicates.typed_acceptance: Requires source, explicit event/null trigger, complete supplied guard multiset, and closed domain matching native choice group.
predicates.backend_domain: One native choice group in FBMCQ.
predicates.quantifier: Universal coverage of the declared domain by group guard disjunction.
predicates.timing_rtc: Static guard-domain coverage, not runtime event dispatch or priority.
predicates.observable: Guard AST multiset and declared valuation domain.
predicates.approximation: Exact only under a complete source-backed finite/expressible domain and exact group binding; no claim about unspecified environment values.
predicates.bound_domain: Caller-declared closed domain, no invented values.
predicates.boolean_boundary: Missing/mismatched guard group, invalid input/domain, timeout, or solver failure is unknown, not a coverage failure.
predicates.evaluation_only_reuse: Exact only where source fixes a complete checkable domain and all guards of one native group; otherwise unsupported.
semantic_gaps: domain may be underspecified in NL
missing_test_cases: Incomplete domain must not be treated as total coverage
eventless choice group must use explicit null trigger

predicates.registry_semantics: After every supported occurrence of p, q occurs within the declared bound and unit.
predicates.typed_acceptance: p accepts only a native state or event proposition, q only a native state proposition, bound is positive integer, unit must be steps, and scope must resolve to closed native scope.
predicates.backend_domain: FBMCQ response formula over native closed scope.
predicates.quantifier: Universal response for every supported p occurrence in bounded execution.
predicates.scope: Closed native state/event response fragment only.
predicates.timing_rtc: Response starts at a strict successor and uses positive integer macrostep bound.
predicates.observable: State/event trigger and state response, not compound/global/termination propositions in wrapper inputs.
predicates.approximation: pyfcstm FBMCQ language can express broader Boolean bodies, but frozen V3 wrapper cannot bind terminated(), compound q, or general formulas.
predicates.bound_domain: Positive integer steps; finite BMC/response horizon.
predicates.boolean_boundary: Invalid proposition/unit/scope, solver failure, timeout, or incomplete response suffix is not false; only closed Boolean receipt counts.
predicates.evaluation_only_reuse: Exact only for same strict-successor state/event-to-state response within a source-specified positive step bound; composite, terminated, or global propositions need evaluation-only oracle or unsupported status.
missing_test_cases: terminated() must be rejected by V3 wrapper although FBMCQ supports it
compound response must not be silently reduced to a state

predicates.registry_semantics: Every reachable, stable, nonterminal configuration admits model progress.
predicates.typed_acceptance: Requires a closed initial scope resolving to native stable nonterminal leaf configurations.
predicates.backend_domain: Topology-selected native stable leaves plus one-macrostep FBMCQ successor checks.
predicates.quantifier: Universal over topology-reachable stable leaves in scope; existential one-macrostep successor or termination for each.
predicates.scope: A resolved closed native initial scope expanded to stable leaf configurations.
predicates.timing_rtc: One real post-step configuration change or termination; not global all-input eventual progress.
predicates.observable: Stable leaf stoppability and an existential native macrostep successor/termination.
predicates.approximation: Topology selects candidates and per-leaf successor exists; no universal event environment, no unbounded termination, no full configuration-space proof.
predicates.bound_domain: Per-leaf finite one-step FBMCQ query; scope finite native leaf set.
predicates.boolean_boundary: If any per-leaf query is non-Boolean the predicate is unknown; false only identifies a completed blocked leaf query.
predicates.evaluation_only_reuse: Exact only for the narrow one-step existential progress condition on exactly the selected stable leaves; use proxy/unsupported for global liveness or required recovery behavior.
missing_test_cases: A terminal leaf must not be reported deadlocked
one enabled event must not prove all-input recovery

predicates.registry_semantics: Every reachable configuration satisfies the expected occupancy value of the specified state.
predicates.typed_acceptance: Requires one exact native state, expected occupancy 0 or 1, and a closed native initial scope.
predicates.backend_domain: Incremental FBMCQ active-state invariant over native initial scope.
predicates.quantifier: Universal active-state occupancy over BMC frames through derived horizon.
predicates.scope: One exact state under closed native initial scope.
predicates.timing_rtc: Finite macrostep BMC frames; a false result can close early with a replayed lower-bound counterexample, while true requires the requested horizon to close.
predicates.observable: Exact state active/not-active occupancy in each bounded configuration.
predicates.approximation: Horizon is derived from native state count; no unbounded invariant proof, no arbitrary Boolean invariant.
predicates.bound_domain: Incremental finite horizon up to native state count.
predicates.boolean_boundary: Invalid state/occupancy/scope, non-Boolean intermediate query, solver failure, or replay failure is unknown/error; false only has completed witness, true only after full horizon closure.
predicates.evaluation_only_reuse: Exact only for the same finite-horizon occupancy assertion; an unbounded state invariant is a documented proxy and compound invariants are unsupported by V5.
semantic_gaps: horizon depends on artifact state count
missing_test_cases: Early false must preserve a replayed lower-bound witness
true must fail to close before derived horizon

findings.title: Registry step is not consumed by the trajectory backend
findings.observed_contract: run_trajectory chooses scenario.selected_step and never reads plan.inputs['step']; changing the schema field cannot select a different observation macrostep.
findings.declared_contract: Registry and R1Inputs expose scenario, event, and step as the predicate's declared inputs.
findings.gold_impact: A Track B row cannot claim the plan-level step independently controls R1. A selected R1 proposal must freeze the same selected_step inside its source-provenanced scenario or be unsupported.
findings.resolution: The gold protocol treats plan.inputs.step as redundant provenance only, requires selected_step in the immutable scenario, and rejects rows whose source-based selected step cannot be represented there. Frozen runtime is not modified.

findings.title: Effect-set contract collapses to one effect
findings.observed_contract: The backend rejects any effect tuple other than one string and then checks membership of that one parsed operation.
findings.declared_contract: Registry calls S6 effect-set membership and S6Inputs accepts a tuple of required effects.
findings.gold_impact: A row may select S6 only for one exact parseable effect; it cannot use S6 as evidence for a required set, ordered sequence, or composite effect obligation.
findings.resolution: Track B marks multi-effect obligations unsupported or considers a clearly labeled non-exact proxy; exact S6 candidates carry exactly one typed effect. Frozen runtime is not modified.

findings.title: Runtime requires a guard multiset omitted from the registry contract
findings.observed_contract: V1 backend rejects input unless supplied guards exactly equal the native choice-group guard multiset.
findings.declared_contract: Registry and V1Inputs name only source, trigger, and domain.
findings.gold_impact: A proposal cannot present the registry-visible three fields as complete executable binding; it needs a source-provenanced complete guard multiset or must be unsupported.
findings.resolution: Gold protocol requires explicit complete group guards as additional provenance, preserves the mismatch in the audit, and rejects exact V1 assignment when the complete native group cannot be independently bound. Frozen runtime is not modified.

actual_commands: rg -n over frozen registry, typed inputs, four backends, projection adapter, pyfcstm topology/runtime/BMC sources, and conformance tests
sha256sum over all audited frozen sources
reason: This independent source audit constrains safe evaluation-only reuse of frozen predicate implementations before Track B proposes issue-level O/P relations; it neither executes a property nor assigns a ledger issue from v60 output.
basis: The audit compared each registry contract and Pydantic typed input model with the dispatch code and pyfcstm native implementation, then recorded Boolean completion/error boundaries and source-level test gaps.
